newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-KOREANS REPORTED AT WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-KOREANS REPORTED AT WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: A world badminton championship mixed doubles match involving an Olympic gold medallist could be the subject of disciplinary action.

The second round game on Wednesday lasted just eight minutes and ended with a 15-1 15-1 victory for South Koreans Kim Dong-moon and Ra Kyung-min over eighth-seeded compatriots Ha Tae-kwon and Kim Shin-young.
Kim and Ra won gold and silver at the Atlanta Olympics mixed doubles when playing with a different partner. As a new pairing, however, they were obliged to come through qualifying rounds here.

On Wednesday, they swiftly dealt with their seeded opponents but after tournament assistant referee, American Stan Hales, watched the match he confirmed he would be filing a report to referee Torsten Berg.
Under the rules of the International Badminton Federation, the players could be facing a charge of bringing the game into disrepute.
